page: Microsoft Azure E64ps_v6 is an arm64-based virtual machine belonging to the Epsv6 server family. It features 64 dedicated physical cores powered by the Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The architecture allocates one thread per core, providing predictable execution without simultaneous multithreading. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Cache specifications include 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 128 MB of L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or GPUs, though it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results highlight top-tier multi-core performance and memory throughput. The server achieves top-tier status in multi-core CPU stress-ng tests, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench multi-core evaluations. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching top-tier speeds of 465.5 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 203.88 GB/sec for large-block write operations. Database operations and static web serving throughput also rank in the top tier, while single-core performance metrics generally fall within the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E64ps_v6 offers a high-density memory profile relative to its ARM-based compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from the power efficiency of ARM architecture. The lack of bundled local storage requires external storage attachments, which should be factored into deployment planning. Given its high memory capacity, strong multi-core scaling, and top-tier database operation benchmarks, this server is well-suited for relational databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation, and static web serving.
